'''Gass'kin's Used DroidNet''' was a network of used [[Droid/Legends|droid]] warehouses owned and maintained by [[Mad Gass'kin]]. The droids later sold by DroidNet were all reconditioned.<ref name="Look Sir, Droids!" />
